value.text: Got the link for Preschool Sports and Games, Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, and it fits Maya's age band of 3 to 5. It's $280.60 ($290.60 for non-residents), course code 00028147. The public date is Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m., but residents can register from Sep 8, so that's the earlier date to plan around. The page also lists a registration form, so leave some time before it opens. Earlier I had Monday, September 14 at 10:30 a.m. for this, and I'm going by the page now. Nothing is booked yet.
